name: Opaque Ownership and Control
description: Inherent-risk factors where the real owners or controllers of a customer cannot be readily identified or verified. Includes nominee arrangements, bearer instruments, layered offshore entities and mismatches between declared and observed control.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)
Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)

indicators.name: Beneficial owner cannot be identified
indicators.canon: Beneficial owner or controller cannot be identified
indicators.desc: Ownership or governance is opaque and no natural person who owns or controls the entity can be identified after reasonable effort.
indicators.ctx: Ownership chain ends in an entity, trust or foundation with no natural person identified after reasonable effort.
indicators.fp: Some widely held or publicly listed entities have no controlling individual.

indicators.name: Nominee shareholders or directors
indicators.desc: Registered directors or shareholders appear to act for undisclosed principals, serve many entities or have no real decision-making role.
indicators.ctx: Registered shareholders or directors act on behalf of undisclosed principals.
indicators.fp: Professional nominees are lawful when disclosed and regulated.

indicators.name: Bearer shares or bearer instruments
indicators.desc: Entity has issued, or may issue, bearer shares or warrants transferable without registration.
indicators.ctx: Entity has issued, or may issue, bearer shares or warrants transferable without registration.
indicators.fp: Legacy bearer shares may be immobilised or custodied under regulation.

indicators.name: Layered offshore holding structure
indicators.canon: Complex layered structure without commercial rationale
indicators.desc: Multiple tiers of entities, trusts or foundations, often across secrecy or low-transparency jurisdictions, with no evident business or tax reason.
indicators.ctx: Several tiers of entities across secrecy or low-tax jurisdictions sit between the customer and its owners.
indicators.fp: Multinational groups and fund structures can be layered for tax neutrality.

indicators.name: Declared and discovered ownership mismatch
indicators.desc: Registry, media or documents show owners different from those declared by the customer.
indicators.ctx: Registry, media or documents show owners different from those declared by the customer.
indicators.fp: Registries lag and may be outdated.

indicators.name: Trust or foundation with undisclosed parties
indicators.canon: Trust or foundation with undisclosed parties
indicators.desc: Trust, foundation or similar arrangement where settlor, protector or beneficiaries are not disclosed.
indicators.ctx: Trust, foundation or similar arrangement where settlor, protector or beneficiaries are not disclosed.
indicators.fp: Discretionary trusts may have class-defined beneficiaries.

indicators.name: Shell or no-substance entity
indicators.canon: Shell entity with no operating footprint
indicators.desc: Entity has no staff, premises, website or trading history consistent with its stated activity, yet receives significant payments.
indicators.ctx: Entity has no staff, premises, operations or revenue consistent with its stated activities.
indicators.fp: Start-ups, SPVs and holding companies lawfully have few operations.

indicators.name: Common address or agent for many entities
indicators.canon: Registered address shared by many entities
indicators.desc: Customer shares a registered address, mailbox, agent or phone with numerous unrelated companies, such as a mass-registration or virtual office.
indicators.ctx: Customer shares registered address, agent or phone with numerous unrelated companies.
indicators.fp: Registered agent and virtual office addresses are very common.

indicators.name: Control exercised through informal arrangements
indicators.desc: Powers of attorney, side letters or signatories give control to persons not in the ownership chain.
indicators.ctx: Powers of attorney, side letters or signatories give control to persons not in the ownership chain.
indicators.fp: Family, lawyers and fiduciaries often hold legitimate powers.

indicators.name: Recently incorporated entity with large flows
indicators.canon: Newly formed entity with vague purpose and large flows
indicators.desc: Recently incorporated entity or group of entities with generic business descriptions shows significant turnover or purchases soon after formation.
indicators.ctx: New company shows significant turnover or funding soon after formation with no track record.
